title: Tears of Vanfell
description:
Tears of Vanfell is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op.

Explore and climb the procedurally-generated Mountain to find and defeat Bosses, and continue on your journey. 

During your adventure, you'll pick up powerful new abilities, weapons and equipment, all of which you'll need to use if you plan on surviving.

Explore the Mountain with a team of up to four players! Or, if you would rather take on the Mountain by yourself, don't worry -- you may also bring another member of your camp to help you out.

Prepare yourself for your next expedition at your campsite. At first, it will be just you and your thoughts... but as you explore, you'll find others willing to help you out -- from other explorers with unique skills, to specialists who can help behind the scenes.

During your adventures, you'll meet many characters and grow to understand them and their motivations. But you may also find yourself caught up in the aftermath of a century-old war...
description_short: Your life begins anew in front of an imposing mountain... Climb and explore it with a wide cast of characters in this dungeon crawler RPG with up to four player Co-op.
